## Description

Lifts non-linear option implied volatility smile dynamics into linear dynamical spaces using Koopman operator dictionary expansions, pricing exotic options and volatility spreads accurately.

## Where it may fit

Exotic options pricing, volatility arbitrage, earnings announcement implied volatility smile fitting.

## Vehicles

Volatility Arbitrage Funds, Options Market Making Desks.

## Required data

Intraday option chain quotes, implied volatility surface matrices, underlying spot quotes.

## Caveats

Observable dictionary expansion size requires L1 regularization to prevent overfitting across strikes.
